subgoals.objective_name: To prevent unauthorized physical access, damage and interference to the organization's information and information processing facilities.
subgoals.goal_name: Prevent unauthorized physical access, damage and interference to the organization's information and information processing facilities

subgoals.control_name: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities.

subgoals.goal_name: Use security perimeters to protect areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities

actions.label: Encrypt Sensitive Information
actions.definition: Encrypt sensitive data such as ML models to protect against adversaries attempting to access sensitive data.

subgoals.control_name: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.

subgoals.goal_name: Protect secure areas to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access

actions.label: Control Access to ML Models and Data at Rest
actions.definition: Establish access controls on internal model registries and limit internal access to production models. Limit access to training data only to approved users.

subgoals.control_name: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and applied.

subgoals.goal_name: Design physical security for offices, rooms and facilities
Apply physical security for offices, rooms and facilities

subgoals.control_name: Physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attack or accidents shall be designed and applied.

subgoals.goal_name: Design physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attack or accidents
Apply physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attack or accidents

actions.label: Implement Security Control during hardware manufacturing
actions.definition: Implement strict security controls and auditing processes during the manufacturing phase, including secure supply chain practices and hardware verification methods, to prevent unauthorized modifications to hardware components or firmware.

actions.label: Malicious Logic Detection in hardware
actions.definition: Implement comprehensive hardware and firmware security validation processes, including regular integrity checks and the use of cryptographic signing, to detect and prevent the insertion of malicious logic.

subgoals.control_name: Procedures for working in secure areas shall be designed and applied.

subgoals.goal_name: Design procedures for working in secure areas
Apply procedures for working in secure areas

subgoals.control_name: Access points such as delivery and loading areas and other points where unauthorized persons could enter the premises shall be controlled and, if possible, isolated from information processing facilities to avoid unauthorized access.

subgoals.goal_name: Control access points such as delivery and loading areas and other points where unauthorized persons could enter the premises and, if possible
Isolate access points such as delivery and loading areas and other points where unauthorized persons could enter the premises from information processing facilities to avoid unauthorized access

actions.label: Restrict Library Loading
actions.definition:
Prevent abuse of library loading mechanisms in the operating system and software to load untrusted code by configuring appropriate library loading mechanisms and investigating potential vulnerable software.
File formats such as pickle files that are commonly used to store machine learning models can contain exploits that allow for loading of malicious libraries.
